headline: WNBA Playoff Bracket Locked: Lynx claim top seed, Fever face Dream in Round 1
whyCareReason: The eight-team WNBA postseason bracket is set for Sunday 27 September with the Lynx claiming the No. 1 seed and Caitlin Clark's Fever facing the Atlanta Dream in Round 1.
teaser: Playoff bracket locked for Sunday 27 September: (1) Lynx vs (8) Mystics, (2) Valkyries vs (7) Liberty, (3) Aces vs (6) Wings, (4) Dream vs (5) Fever.
story:
Why this one matters: The WNBA regular season has officially wrapped following Indiana's 96-77 statement over Minnesota. The eight-team postseason bracket is locked for tip-off on Sunday 27 September.

WNBA.com official seeds: Minnesota Lynx (32-10) enter as the No. 1 overall seed. The Golden State Valkyries (31-11) capture the No. 2 seed in their second year, with the defending champion Las Vegas Aces (29-13) at No. 3 and Atlanta Dream (28-14) at No. 4.

Round 1 best-of-three matchups: (1) Lynx vs (8) Mystics, (2) Valkyries vs (7) Liberty, (3) Aces vs (6) Wings, and the blockbuster (4) Dream vs (5) Fever featuring Caitlin Clark. Semifinals will be best of five, with the Finals best of seven. The race for the 2026 crown begins Sunday.
stakes: Home court, a one-seed, and opening-round best-of-three series starting Sunday 27 September.
rivalryAngle: Top-seeded Lynx and defending champion Aces face surging challengers in a loaded eight-team field.
